(497)kun mkhyen lugs kyi sgyu 'phrul zhi khro gtong lugs/rtsa gtor/zhi gtor/drag gtor gnyis/cha gsum/dkar gtor/bgegs gtor gnyis/tshogs gnyis chad tha

tei:div.tei:p: kun mkhyen lugs kyi sgyu 'phrul zhi khro gtong lugs/ rtsa gtor/ zhi gtor/ drag gtor gnyis/ cha gsum/ dkar gtor/ bgegs gtor gnyis/ tshogs gnyis chad tho gcig brtan ma gnyis/ gsol ka gtor 'bul bcas/ 'don 'grigs ni/ sems skyed sdom chog tshig bdun/ spros bral sku gsum/ rgyal ba chos kyi sku yi lta bu gcig 'di ltar mig gi lta bu bzhi/ 'dzam gling sogs sho lo ka bdun/ bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs= dzaḥ oṃ/ ye shes sku mchog= yo ga khrus gdangs/ rdo rje slob dpon= gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs= yo ga ho/ rdzogs sangs rin chen= dbye bar bgyi/ badz+ra ma hā= dkar gtor/ gang dag 'dir gnas= zhi rol/ dkar/ bhu mi= sarba= sarba bhig+naṃ= gsum/ yo ga bzhi dril gyis/ hūm̐/ yul phyogs= zhi rol/ dung*/ rkang bzhi/ hūm̐/ stong che= nyid kyis srung*/ bar/ yo ga bzhi dril/ oṃ hūm̐/ 'phags mchog= gdangs chen nam/ thugs thig zhi rol brgyud gsum/ rgya/ dkar/ snga phyi gnyis la rkang bzhi/ rnga/ hūm̐ bzhi/ yo ga'am lhug bdag nyid lhar gsal= rgya mtshor gyur/ bh+yo bi shwa= gcig oṃ badz+ra rā ga puṣ+pe= sogs rang rgya las/ pad skor se gol med/ nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las= sarba pañtsa= nyer gcig swa bhā wa= stong pa'i= sngags gsum/ swa bhā ba= a las= sngags gsum/ khrus gdangs sam/ lhug bdag dang= lnga/ dngos rnams de bzhin= dngos po= a rab tu= a las mtha' dbus= ye shes phyogs bzhi=(498) snyan gdangs sam/ dal 'don gyis/ lhun po'i steng du= seng ge= gzhal yas= gdan la= gzhi'i āḥyig= tshigs bcad rnams yo ga'am lhug ye shes kyi 'khor lor bzhugs pa'o: gdan gsum= sngags tshan nas/ dkyil 'khor bdag po= a dar+sha= shu ne= sa man+ta= pra te= rnam snying = sa snying = sa ma= a dar+sha= shu ne= pra ti= kṛ te= rin 'byung = pra ti= a dar+sha= sa ma= shu ne= kṛ te= snang ba= kṛ te= a dar+sha=

sa ma= pra ti= shu ne= don yod= lha thams cad kyi= tshan gsum/ gdangs chen gyis/ stong pa shin tu= lha tshogs rnams kyis= bum gdangs sam/ yo gas/ phyogs dus= zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ oṃ badz+ra= lnga/ ye shes rgya mtsho= oṃ badz+ra= gsum/ dza hūm̐= rin chen seng ge'i= rang nyid dkyil 'khor= mi rtog rdo rje= lag pa= gzhung gsal dril bcas phyag rgya/ yo gas/ hūm̐/ sgyu 'phrul= yo gas/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs= khrus gdangs kyis/ yan lag= rdor sems mchod gdangs kyis/ oṃ hūm̐/ spos kyi= bzhi/ rab tu= lhug yo gas dril/ sman mchod/ sangs rgyas= dkon mchog= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje= oṃ hūm̐= bla med= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mi bskyod= oṃ/ mchod pa'i= rang gi= hūm̐/ thog mar= yab kyi= oṃ hūm̐/ 'khril ba'i= gza' dang = oṃ/ dbang po'i= zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ ḍā/ zhog tshogs grol// tsha rting la/ dril stabs/ oṃ/ phyogs bcu= yo ga rang rgya/ thal sbyar/ hoḥ spros pa= yo ga bzhi dril/ oṃ hūm̐/ bde bar gshegs pa= yan lag= lhug bh+rūm̐ bi shwa= hūm̐/(499)badz+ra= sum brgya/ rigs bzhi brgya/ sems dpa' lnga cu/ sgo bzhi yid chos nyer lnga/ thub drug bco lnga/ oṃ bho dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dharma dhartu āḥ sum brgya/ tshogs zhus/ ma hā= raṃ yaṃ khaṃḥ stong par= yo ga oṃ/ bsod nams= zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ yo gas/ spos kyi rang rgya/ hūm̐/ thabs dang= hoḥ bde bar= zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ tshogs drang ba/ mnyam nyid= lan/ a a= thams cad kyis/ hoḥ bdag lus= bsam lhun/ tshogs grol// ༈ gung tshogs la/ hoḥ bdag cag rdo rje= rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor= hūm̐/ las kyi rdo rje= thugs thig gdangs/ hoḥ mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i= mkha' 'gro so gnyis/ badz+ra puṣ+pe= zhi rol/ dung*/ dkar/ rnga/ oṃ badz+ra ḍāk+ki ni= a phaṭaḥ lhag zhus/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ yo ga'am lhag gdangs/ hūm̐/ rnam dag= hūm̐/ mkha' 'gro= ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hiḥ ma hā rak+ta khā hiḥ hoḥ lhag sdud=

cig: zhi rol/ dung*/ dkar/ ḍā/ rkang bzhi/ ya hiḥ hūm̐/ lhag ma'i= traṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brtan ma'i gdangs/ hūm̐/ tshogs dang= khā hiḥ hoḥ brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs= sogs gong ltar zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ ya hi gats+tshaḥ gong gi phyi mchod byin rlabs/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ rnga/ kun bzang= zhabs bsil= bzhi bsnol/ sman raka gtor gsum/ brjod med= yig brgya gsum/ phyogs bcu na= bcas spyi ltar/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa= ngang du gyur/ hūm̐ badz+ra dhṛg rdo rje sems dpa'= skur gyur/ rang nyid= lus (500)thams cad= thams cad ma lus= oṃ truṃ= lnga/ gnas de dang= rat+na mu ku= lnga/ rat+na ma le= ār+ya lam bho gu h+ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ yig brgya gsum/ dge ba 'di yi= rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub= ༈ khro bo ni/ bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba= gong ltar skyabs 'gro gsum/ sems bskyed gsum/ rdo rje slob dpon= gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐= tshogs= badz+ra ma hā shṝ= bdag nyid= ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sarba bhigh+naṃ= gsum/ dung*/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūm̐/ nga ni= dung chen/ sum gcig sil/ rkang bzhi/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ sru 'khor/ brda sgo phyag sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ byin 'bebs/ brgyud gsum rol mo spyi ltar/ rnga rol gzhag bdag nyid lhar gsal= lhug zhi rol/ rgya/ dung*/ ḍā/ dkar/ sman gtor raka dngos rnams= nas lhug badz+ra kro dhi shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ bar/ dung*/ rgya/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ bdag nyid= rnga 'don/ gsal bar snang*/ sum gcig dung*/ sil/ bzhag rol/ thabs dang= man lhug khams gsum gyi dbang phyug chen po'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'o/ dwangs chen grol// ༈ bar tshogs dang po la/ rang gi thugs rin po che= phyag rgya gzhung gsal/ lha skyed yongs rdzogs/ bdag nyid du gnas par gyur/ gtso bo'i ye shes sems dpa'= rkang bzhi/

dung*/ rgya/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūm̐/ phyogs dus= hūm̐/ rdo rje= 'jam rol/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang bzhi/ ḍā/ bzhag rol/ dam tshig pa'i thugs ka= lhug oṃ badz+ra kro dha= oṃ:khro bo la= rnga 'don/ stsol:(501)oṃ badz+ra= gsum/ lhug a le hūm̐ he phaṭaḥ lhug hūm̐/ sems can= rnga 'don/ badz+ra/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor= lhug hūm̐/ bdag dam tshig= rnga 'don/ su hoṃ/ rnga rol gzhag yo ga'am/ lnga btegs/ hūm̐/ rnam pa= rang rgya/ yo ga kho nas/ kun bzang zhabs sil= bzhi bsnol/ rab tu dga' ba'i= lhug yo gas/ sman mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnam snang= man rnga 'don kho nas/ gtor ma gsang nan rak+ta gsum/ hūm̐ bh+yo raṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ hūm̐/ thog mar= sbrel/ bsgral mchod/ sbyor mchod/ 'dod don/ rol mo/ dgyes par mdzod/ sum gcig dung*/ rgya/ rkang bzhi/ sil/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūm̐/ gtum chen= rnga 'don/ 'thor rlung che hoḥ sum gcig dung*/ sil/ bzhag rol/ oṃ badz+ra e sa= lhug hoḥ spros pa= yo ga bzhi dril/ oṃ hūm̐/ bde bar gshegs pa= dril bzhag bh+rūm̐ bi shwa= lhug gtso sngags sum brgya/ oṃ bud+dha shṝ he ru ka hūm̐/ bud+dha kro dhi shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ ru lu sbrel ma brgya/ rat+na brgya/ pad+ma brgya/ karma brgya/ ke'u seng sgo bzhi re nyer gcig re/ dbang mo re bdun re/ ru lu stong*/ rkang bzhi/ dung*/ rgya/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ hūm̐/ dus gsum rnga 'don/ cig ye nas= rnga 'don/ dung*/ 'jam rol/ bzhag rol/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha= lnga/ khro la= kro dha gsum/ hūm̐/ ye shes kyi= yig brgya gsum/ tshogs grol/ ༈ bar tshogs gnyis pa la/ ma mgon lcam dral nas/ gser skyems yan/ dam can rgya mtsho= sum gcig sil bzhag rgya/ dung*/ tshogs zhus/ thing gcig rgya/ dung*/ (Musical notes and signs here) sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ tshogs byin rlabs/ rgya/ dung*/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ spyan 'dren/ 'jam rol/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang bzhi/ tshogs mchod/ rgya/ dung*/ sum gnyis/

'jog med/ bar bshags/ kha 'bud med/ 'jam rol/ bzhag rol/ (502)na mo/ rig 'dzin= khyad par khrag 'thung khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor= dung*/ rkang*/ 'gugs rol dgu/ byer/ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ tshogs bsgral/ lhug gtubs: rkang bzhi/ dung*/ 'jam rol bzhag tshogs drang ba/ cha gsum lhug bzhi rdeb gnyis la kha 'bud med/ sum bha= zhi rol la dkar/ 'byung po= tshogs grol/ ༈ dgong tshogs la/ he ru ka yi= dung*/ thing gcig sum gsum/ 'jog yod/ kye/ dang po= phyir: lhag zhus/ byin rlabs spyi ltar/ thing gcig dung*/ ḍā/ sil/ bzlog rol che bas/ hūm̐/ rnam dag= dal 'dur/ mthar/ bzlog rol che ba/ sil/ dung*/ rkang*/ rnga bzhag rol/ gsol ka bkyags/ bskul/ sum gnyis/ chad tho sum gnyis/ brtan ma sum gnyis/ rta bro sum gcig bsil/ bzhag rol/ dung chen ṇir/ oṃ shṝ badz+ra he ru ka sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= thing gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ bdag med phyogs bral= bstod: nongs bshags/ yig brgya gsum/ grol nyin dang po grub/ zhi rol/ 'dir ni rten dang= bsdu ldang*/ yig brgya gcig bsngo smon gsum/ bkra shis rnga 'don/ sum gcig thing gsum/ sil/ bzhag rol bya bas grub bo/ bsngo smon spyi ltar ro// de ni sgyu 'phrul zhi khro phyogs gcig gtong lugs yin/ so sor btang yang chog gnas 'dren dgos tshe zhi khro ngan song sbyong ba dang sbrel// dge'o//
